title: BIR / CIR — frozen serialization contract (#37)
description: The durable ABI for kotlin/clr's backend interchange. BIR (kotc→bir2cir) and CIR (bir2cir→ilemit) share ONE schema; they differ only by lowering stage, not shape. Names shown are the post-m5 canonical form (the m6 validator enforces this document). Version tag: bir-json/1.
$comment: A BIR/CIR file is a compilation unit. CARRIER (§0) is OUT OF SCOPE for this document schema: inline payloads and suspend fn-types are not document roots — they ride as CLR attributes on the EMITTED assembly ([KotlinInline(string version, byte[] content)] / [KotlinSuspendFunctionType(...)], codec version 'bir-json/1'). A decoded [KotlinInline] content is the §0 payload object {v,fqn,owner,fileClass,recv,static,typeParams,params,ret,body,lifted}; its body nodes, types, and lifted method declarations use this schema's vocabulary. [KotlinSuspendFunctionType] decodes to a $defs/type (an fn with suspend:true). The attribute ctor and inline-payload envelope live in spec §0, not here.

refTypes.$comment: #52 BIR-ONLY transient: the heap-ref-cell registry ({name, element type}). bir2cir's SharedSyntheticSynthesis ASSEMBLES each `dotkt$<scope>$Ref$<elem>{ var v }` cell class from it, then DROPS the key — absent in CIR.

type.description: A Type is ALWAYS an object with a `t` discriminator. There is NO bare-string type. Readers dispatch(t); they never split/scan a string. Eight variants; `star` is BIR-only and bir2cir must eliminate it before CIR.

tFqn.description: A named type — a PURE Kotlin/CLR FQN identity. kotc emits identity ONLY; bir2cir DERIVES the CLR form (primitive opcode / generic construction / referenced-type resolution). Replaces plain-FQN, clr:, clrg:Name[..], @Name, and the primitive shorthand (int/string/void/object/…).

name.description: e.g. kotlin.Int, kotlin.collections.List, System.Exception, dotkt$CharSequence (a compiler-generated synthetic — `$` is Kotlin-unspeakable; the def carries generated:true)

tTv.description: A type variable. `scope` is the CLR generic-param SPACE (distinct on the CLR); `i` the owner-local FLATTENED positional index. scope+i map straight to !i / !!i. Replaces gp:X (name-keyed).

scope.description: type → enclosing type's params (CLR !i); method → the method's own params (CLR !!i)

tStar.description: A Kotlin `*` projection. BIR preserves this Kotlin type-system fact; bir2cir lowers it to a provenance-backed CLR existential representation. It is invalid in CIR.

tFn.description: A function type; subsumes plain AND suspend (the H2 position metadata is just an fn with suspend:true). Replaces func:/sfunc:.

ctx.description: Reference-metadata-only: the CONTEXT parameters of a Kotlin context function type, restored from [KotlinContextFunctionType(N)] while constructing the reference KLIB. `context(A) B.(D) -> E` reads back as ctx=[A], recv=B, params=[D]. kotc BIR MUST omit it — there the fact rides the declaration-slot key `ctxFnType`, because a type node is rebuilt by many lowering passes and would lose it.

clr.description: CIR-only physical delegate family, authored by bir2cir after Kotlin-to-CLR lowering. kotc BIR MUST omit it; every fn that reaches ilemit MUST carry it.

tOblivious.description: T! — an NRT-OBLIVIOUS flexible type (T..T?) (NullableAttribute=0). `oblivious` is the CLR/Roslyn term, not the Kotlin-consumer 'platform' name. Reference-metadata-only: dll2klib serializes the flexible lower/upper bounds into the KLIB, so kotc BIR never emits this node.

tByRef.description: a CLR by-ref `ref T`. Replaces byRef:X.

mods.description: Order-free set of name:true flags (absent = not set). Replaces the $kmods string-concat + the final,inline,ext,… comma string + scattered flat booleans. Visibility is NOT a mod (see `vis`).

name.$comment: the tv NAME is retained on the DECLARATION; references use positional tv{scope,i}

param.description: A value parameter. Nullability lives on `type` (§1). #48 STATUS: FOLDED — the sibling `nullable` decl flag is RETIRED; kotc emits the `?` on the `type` node (`{t:nullable,of:T}`). bir2cir's `DeclNullableFlags` derives the flattened `NullableAttribute` byte array (`nullableFlags`) from the reference-nullable positions of the type before `ReferenceNullableStrip` strips the wrappers.

nullableFlags.$comment: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes (0=oblivious,1=not-null,2=nullable) for this param's reference-nullable positions; RoundtripMetadata folds it into the param's `attrs` as a NullableAttribute entry, which ilemit stamps. Absent when the type carries no nullable-reference position.

mods.$comment: only vararg/noinline/crossinline/context apply to a param; `context` marks a Kotlin context parameter (physically an ordinary positional slot, restored AS a context parameter by a consuming Kotlin module)

ctxFnType.description: How many of the slot function type's LEADING physical arguments (recv first, then params) are Kotlin CONTEXT parameters: `context(A) B.(D) -> E` is `@ExtensionFunctionType Function3<A,B,D,E>`, so 1 — contexts precede the receiver. Absent = an ordinary function type. fir2ir ERASES the fact (it makes `context(A) B.(D) -> E` the SAME IrType as `B.(A,D) -> E`), so kotc recovers it from FIR and carries it here; bir2cir turns it into [KotlinContextFunctionType(N)]. Without it a consuming module restores the context AS the extension receiver and a lambda's `this` silently binds to the wrong value.

kind.description: delegate is CIR-only: an exact CLR delegate declaration carrying params/ret and an arity-qualified metadata name

generated.description: #68: compiler-generated synthetic (closure/ref-cell/KProperty/CharSequence/ClrH/lifted-anon); ilemit stamps [CompilerGenerated] from it — replaces the retired `<>dotkt_` name-sniff

_syntheticTypeArgs.$comment: #68 BIR-ONLY transient on a LIFTED SYNTHETIC (kotc emits it on a lifted local `fun`; bir2cir's ClosureSynthesis derives the same key for a lifted closure class): positionally, which ORIGINAL enclosing `tv` each of the synthetic's own typeParams re-declares. The lift re-declares those params, but its body still names them in the ENCLOSING frame, so a consumer that must re-express one in the lift's own frame reads the correspondence here — bir2cir's SharedSyntheticSynthesis uses it to construct a bare heap-ref-cell identity used inside the lift. Consumed and DROPPED there — absent in CIR.

kotlinCompanion.description: #275 BIR semantic fact on a companion declaration. bir2cir consumes it when selecting the ordinary nested CLR carrier and emits explicit round-trip metadata.

capturedTypeParams.description: #275 CIR-only names of enclosing CLR generic slots physically captured by a nested companion carrier. Declaration names, not Type usages.

pos.$comment: #112 P2: OPTIONAL decl-level SOURCE POSITION (File.kt:line), threaded kotc -> BIR -> CIR so an ilemit/bir2cir emit failure or a shared IrSanity violation points at the originating declaration. Diagnostics-only; absent = pre-#112 behavior (a synthetic with no source omits it). Numeric l/c so the schema validator's bare-string check is not tripped; pos.f is the one string (verify-schema.py STR_OK).

l.description: 1-based line; absent/-1 when only the file is known

generated.description: Compiler-generated method declaration (lifted lambda/local-function/callable-reference target or a lowerer synthetic). ilemit maps this CIR fact 1:1 to [CompilerGenerated]; dll2klib excludes the method from the restored Kotlin API.

retCtxFnType.$comment: The RETURN-position twin of a parameter's `ctxFnType`: how many of the returned function type's LEADING physical arguments are Kotlin CONTEXT parameters. fir2ir erases the fact, so kotc recovers it from FIR; bir2cir folds it into the method's `retAttrs` as [KotlinContextFunctionType(N)]. Absent when the return is not a context function type.

retNullableFlags.$comment: #48: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes for the RETURN's reference-nullable positions (the retired scalar `retNullable` flag's replacement); RoundtripMetadata folds it into the method's `retAttrs` as a NullableAttribute entry, which ilemit stamps on the return parameter. Absent when the return carries no nullable-reference position.

static.$comment: a load-bearing CLR-shape flag, kept scalar (not a Kotlin source modifier)

clrBridgeRole.$comment: reverse-enumerator-bridge role marker bir2cir (IteratorBridgeMarking) stamps so ilemit drives its GetEnumerator adapter off a semantic marker, never the Kotlin FQN/member names — hasNext/next on kotlin.collections.Iterator's members, iterator on a class iterator(). A bir2cir->ilemit resolution HINT (ilemit reads it into TypeInfo.BridgeRoles), never emitted as .NET metadata.

_syntheticTypeArgs.$comment: #68 BIR-ONLY transient on a LIFTED SYNTHETIC (kotc emits it on a lifted local `fun`; bir2cir's ClosureSynthesis derives the same key for a lifted closure class): positionally, which ORIGINAL enclosing `tv` each of the synthetic's own typeParams re-declares. The lift re-declares those params, but its body still names them in the ENCLOSING frame, so a consumer that must re-express one in the lift's own frame reads the correspondence here — bir2cir's SharedSyntheticSynthesis uses it to construct a bare heap-ref-cell identity used inside the lift. Consumed and DROPPED there — absent in CIR.

nullableFlags.$comment: #48: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes for the slot's reference-nullable positions (replaces the retired scalar `nullable` flag).
#48: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes for the slot's reference-nullable positions (replaces the retired scalar `nullable` flag).

node.description: Every node is a {k}-tagged object. ~60 canonical kinds; k + all field names are lowerCamelCase. A type-valued field always holds a $defs/type. Dispatch on k; never scan a string.

nodeKind.$comment: Representative kotc-emit set. The AUTHORITATIVE frozen kind set (the union of every kind the toolchain emits across a full fresh build, incl. the CLR-lowered `clr*`, coroutine-lowered `co*`, structured `for`, and the not-yet-merged `setFieldExpr`/`staticFieldSet` field-write variants) lives in the m6 validator's KINDS (scripts/verify-schema.py; regenerate with --dump-kinds). The validator rejects any k outside it. (cond = ternary expression; if = statement.)

nodeByKind.$comment: Representative canonical shapes; the validator pins the full per-kind field set. Canonical field vocabulary below.

joinNullBranch.$comment: BIR-ONLY frontend fact (#86 §3): the frontend resolved this value-position JOIN to a NON-nullable type while some branch yields a literal null. Stamped by kotc on the declaration it MINTS for the join (a try-expression temp, each cond of a when chain); consumed and REMOVED by bir2cir ValueJoinNullWidening, which widens a VALUE join to Nullable<V> and leaves a reference join alone. Never reaches CIR.

prop.$comment: A2 step 3/4: BIR-ONLY accessor KIND on a .NET member access — for get/set the bare `method` = property name and bir2cir applies the get_/set_ convention into clrPropGet/clrPropSet; for index-get/index-set `method` is the faithful `get`/`set` operator and bir2cir resolves the .NET type's DEFAULT INDEXED PROPERTY accessor (get_Item/[IndexerName]) off the refs. Never in CIR.

calleeOwner.$comment: #199 Design B: OPTIONAL FIR-resolved callee file-class DISPATCH hint on an owner:null (top-level) callStatic. Advisory (the owner-null substitution/recognition axis IGNORES it); ONLY ilemit dispatch consults it, to disambiguate two same-simple-name top-level funcs across packages. Mirrors `sty`.

prop.$comment: A2 step 3: BIR-ONLY accessor KIND on a .NET-property access — bare `method` = property name; bir2cir applies the get_/set_ convention into clrPropGet/clrPropSet. Never in CIR.

oneOf.$comment: was `un`; the single operand is `e` (the canonical one-sub-expr field, shared with conv/cast/isInst/cond/if/nullable*)

nullMatches.$comment: null answers TRUE — the Kotlin type operand was NULLABLE (`x is T?`). Set by bir2cir's NullableIsInstMatch in BIR-space (type lowering erases the `?`, since every CLR reference is nullable); ilemit projects it as the extra `dup; brtrue` before the isinst. Absent = the plain non-null is-test.

joinNullBranch.$comment: BIR-ONLY frontend fact (#86 §3): the frontend resolved this value-position JOIN to a NON-nullable type while some branch yields a literal null. Stamped by kotc on the declaration it MINTS for the join (a try-expression temp, each cond of a when chain); consumed and REMOVED by bir2cir ValueJoinNullWidening, which widens a VALUE join to Nullable<V> and leaves a reference join alone. Never reaches CIR.

synthClass.$comment: #52 BIR-ONLY transient: the ingredient bag for bir2cir's ClosureSynthesis to ASSEMBLE the closure class (name + capture fields{name,type} + invoke params/ret/body + optional generic typeParams). STRIPPED in CIR — the lean node (closureType+captures values+funcType+typeArgs) is what ilemit consumes for the `new`.

typeParams.$comment: the SM's own generic-param NAME declarations (the enclosing free type params it is generic over) — a type-param DECL name list (the `typeParams` name-shorthand, §2.5), NOT a type-USAGE slot; renamed from `typeArgs` in m6

typeArgs.$comment: OPTIONAL construction channel (#75 Batch B, 2A): the ORIGINAL enclosing tvs (type-USAGE nodes, any scope/index) the open SM is INSTANTIATED with — `new smName<typeArgs…>(…)`. Distinct from `typeParams` (the SM's DECL names). Emitted by InlineSplice.MaterializeSuspendCarrier when it renumbers a carrier's enclosing tvs to a dense SM param space; ABSENT on kotc's own source-lambda emission (positional `smName<tv{type,0..N-1}>` fallback).

capValues.$comment: OPTIONAL per-capture construction-value overrides (positional, aligned with `captures`; a null slot falls back to the descriptor-name synthesis). Set by SuspendColdLowering (GAP 2, an SM-vocabulary spill) and by InlineSplice 2B (an `__outer` rebound to the splice's receiver temp).

funcType.$comment: Canonical Kotlin function type. An extension receiver is carried only in fn.recv; fn.params contains regular parameters. The physical node params array remains receiver-first because it supplies SM field names/create arguments.

oneOf.$comment: #275 BIR-only semantic companion singleton access; bir2cir binds it to the trusted nested CLR carrier and no instance survives to CIR.
CIR-only CLR-static callable-reference construction. bir2cir has already resolved the physical memberSig/memberOwner descriptors that ilemit consumes one-to-one.
value-type nullable wrap; operand `e`, element type `elem` (shared with nullableValue/nullableHasValue/nullableNull)

§2.7: the RESERVATION for a cross-module omitted default. Emitted by kotc ONLY as the `expr` of a default-phase plan binding; bir2cir's DefaultArgSplice materialises the callee's [kotlin.clr.KotlinDefault] carrier into that binding, and refuses one found anywhere else. Never in CIR.

§2.7 CALL-EVALUATION PLAN, BIR-only. `bindings` is the call's supplied values in KOTLIN EVALUATION ORDER (dispatch receiver, extension receiver, positional arguments, then the filled defaults in declaration order); `expr` is the call, whose every read of one of them is a `bindRef`. bir2cir's CallEvalLowering lowers it to a `valueBlock` of `var`s (or, for a constructor delegation carried as the declaration's `delegationBindings`, to `preStmts`).
§2.7: a pure READ of the plan binding `id`. Free to clone — cloning a read is not cloning an evaluation. BIR-only.
…remaining kinds in the nodeKind enum follow the same {k, canonical-fields} pattern; enumerated in full by the m6 validator.

binding.description: One value a call supplies, in the plan's evaluation-order position. `id` is the `bindRef` key, minted in a per-producer namespace (kotc `dotkt$bN`, bir2cir `cir$bN`) and re-minted wherever a plan is cloned into another document; the local it may lower to gets its name from CallEvalLowering, in the frame that holds it. `expr` is the value; for a cross-module omitted default it is the `{k:defaultArg}` RESERVATION DefaultArgSplice fills. BIR-only: CallEvalLowering consumes the whole array.

phase.description: where the value comes from; the array order already carries the evaluation order, so this is documentation and diagnostics, not a sort key

kind.description: `address` = a byref/@ClrRefArgument slot's addressable lvalue: an ordering marker only, never storage

stable.description: may be READ more than once (a literal, an immutable local read) — judged ONCE by the producer and consumed, never re-derived

type.description: the CALLER-instantiated semantic type of the value

role.description: the source-level phrase a storage refusal names the value by ("receiver of 'copy'"); travels onto the lowered `var`
